{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module FileProcessor where

import System.IO
import System.Directory
import System.FilePath
import System.Environment
import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import System.Posix.Files
import System.Posix.Types
import System.Posix.IO

-- Configuration loaded from environment
data ProcessorConfig = ProcessorConfig
  { stagingDir    :: FilePath
  , outputDir     :: FilePath
  , lockTimeout   :: Int        -- microseconds
  , verifyOwner   :: Bool
  , atomicMove    :: Bool
  }

loadConfig :: IO ProcessorConfig
loadConfig = do
  staging <- getEnv "PROC_STAGING_DIR"
  output  <- getEnv "PROC_OUTPUT_DIR"
  timeout <- maybe 500000 read <$> lookupEnv "PROC_LOCK_TIMEOUT"
  verify  <- maybe True (== "1") <$> lookupEnv "PROC_VERIFY_OWNER"
  atomic  <- maybe True (== "1") <$> lookupEnv "PROC_ATOMIC_MOVE"
  return ProcessorConfig
    { stagingDir  = staging
    , outputDir   = output
    , lockTimeout = timeout
    , verifyOwner = verify
    , atomicMove  = atomic
    }

-- Validate that a filename is a single, safe path component.
-- Rejects empty names, '.'/'..', absolute paths, and any name
-- containing path separators or parent-directory references,
-- preventing path traversal (CWE-22).
isSafeFilename :: FilePath -> Bool
isSafeFilename name =
     not (null name)
  && name /= "."
  && name /= ".."
  && not (isAbsolute name)
  && not (any isPathSeparator name)
  && (takeFileName name == name)

-- Lock registry to prevent concurrent processing of same file
type LockRegistry = MVar (Map.Map FilePath UTCTime)

newLockRegistry :: IO LockRegistry
newLockRegistry = newMVar Map.empty

acquireLock :: LockRegistry -> FilePath -> Int -> IO Bool
acquireLock registry path timeout = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  result <- tryTakeMVar registry
  case result of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just locks -> do
      let existing = Map.lookup path locks
      case existing of
        Just ts -> do
          putMVar registry locks
          return False
        Nothing -> do
          putMVar registry (Map.insert path now locks)
          return True

releaseLock :: LockRegistry -> FilePath -> IO ()
releaseLock registry path = do
  locks <- takeMVar registry
  putMVar registry (Map.delete path locks)

-- Verify file ownership using file descriptor (no TOCTOU)
verifyFileOwnershipFd :: Fd -> IO Bool
verifyFileOwnershipFd fd = do
  status <- getFdStatus fd
  myUid  <- getRealUserID
  return (fileOwner status == myUid)

-- Core processing: read from fd, transform, write to output
processFileContentFd :: Fd -> FilePath -> IO (Either String ())
processFileContentFd srcFd dst = do
  -- Read from the already-opened and verified file descriptor
  content <- fdReadAll srcFd
  let transformed = map processChar content
  writeFile dst transformed
  return (Right ())
  where
    processChar c
      | c == '\t' = ' '
      | otherwise = c
    fdReadAll fd = do
      (str, _) <- fdRead fd 65536
      if null str then return "" else do
        rest <- fdReadAll fd
        return (str ++ rest)

-- Main file processing pipeline
processFile :: ProcessorConfig -> LockRegistry -> FilePath -> IO (Either String ())
processFile config registry filename = do
  -- Step 0: Validate the filename to prevent path traversal (CWE-22)
  unless (isSafeFilename filename) $
    error $ "Invalid filename: " ++ filename

  let srcPath = stagingDir config </> filename
      dstPath = outputDir config </> filename
  
  -- Step 1: Verify file exists in staging
  exists <- doesFileExist srcPath
  unless exists $ error $ "File not found: " ++ srcPath
  
  -- Step 2: Acquire processing lock
  locked <- acquireLock registry filename (lockTimeout config)
  unless locked $ error $ "Could not acquire lock for: " ++ filename
  
  -- Step 3: Open file descriptor FIRST, then verify on the fd
  -- This eliminates TOCTOU: we check and read from the SAME fd
  fd <- openFd srcPath ReadOnly Nothing defaultFileFlags
  
  when (verifyOwner config) $ do
    owned <- verifyFileOwnershipFd fd
    unless owned $ do
      closeFd fd
      releaseLock registry filename
      error $ "Ownership verification failed: " ++ srcPath
  
  -- Step 4: Process the file using the same fd (no race window)
  result <- processFileContentFd fd dstPath
  closeFd fd
  
  -- Step 5: Cleanup
  case result of
    Right () -> do
      when (atomicMove config) $ removeFile srcPath
      releaseLock registry filename
      return (Right ())
    Left err -> do
      releaseLock registry filename
      return (Left err)

-- Batch processor that handles queued files
runBatchProcessor :: ProcessorConfig -> LockRegistry -> [FilePath] -> IO [Either String ()]
runBatchProcessor config registry files = do
  mapM (processFile config registry) files

-- Entry point
main :: IO ()
main = do
  config   <- loadConfig
  registry <- newLockRegistry
  files    <- getDirectoryContents (stagingDir config)
  let validFiles = filter isSafeFilename files
  results <- runBatchProcessor config registry validFiles
  let failures = filter isLeft results
  putStrLn $ "Processed: " ++ show (length results) ++ ", Failed: " ++ show (length failures)
  where
    isLeft (Left _) = True
    isLeft _        = False
